summary: Russia has shifted to systemic strikes against Ukraine's rear infrastructure, targeting ports, logistics hubs, metallurgical plants, data centers, and fuel facilities across multiple oblasts, with damage reaching approximately $10 billion in 2026. Ukrainian drone and missile activity is simultaneously striking Russian rear areas including Novorossiysk and oil/gas infrastructure in Saratov, Volgograd, Tula, and Samara regions. A Geran-5 missile/drone was detected 10 km from Poland, and a passenger train locomotive was struck in Volyn 2 km from the Polish border, raising NATO proximity concerns.
key_points: Russian forces struck power substations 'Nova' and 'Usatovo' supporting port and logistics infrastructure in two Ukrainian oblasts, according to the Russian Ministry of Defense (Source: @tass_agency/395208).
Three logistics centers in Odessa Oblast, including 'Nova Poshta,' and UAV workshops were struck by Russian forces, per the Russian Ministry of Defense (Source: @tass_agency/395206).

Systematic Russian strikes have targeted Ukrainian ports in Nikolaev and Odessa region, Chornomorsk (Ilyichevsk), warehouses and logistics hubs in Kyiv and surrounding areas, railway infrastructure, fuel infrastructure, and UAV production and storage facilities (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33219).

Ukrainian metallurgical facilities including Zaporizhstal, enterprises in Krivoy Rog, Interpipe Steel, and the Northern and Novokrivy Rog iron ore mines were struck as part of the campaign against Ukraine's industrial base (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33219).

Ukraine struck the Ozon logistics center in Saratov and targeted oil, industrial, and warehouse facilities in Novorossiysk, Saratov, Volgograd, Tula, Samara regions, and Dagestan (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33219).

Reactive UAVs were detected across multiple Ukrainian oblasts including Dnipropetrovsk (Pavlograd, Kamianske, Petrykivka), Vinnytsia (past Haisyn), and at the Odessa-Mykolaiv border, indicating widespread drone activity (Sources: @kpszsu/78109, @kpszsu/78122, @kpszsu/78120).

A Geran-5 missile-drone was detected 10 km from Poland, and a passenger train locomotive was struck in Volyn 2 km from the Polish border, highlighting escalating strike proximity to NATO territory (Sources: @mon1tor_ua/74445, @eRadarrua/113150).

Oleshky on Kherson Oblast is under complete blockade with mined approaches and constant shelling and drone attacks, cutting off civilian access to food, medicine, and essentials (Source: @UkraineNow/84079).

Multiple Shahed drone launches were detected from Sumy, Chernihiv, Zhytomyr, Kyiv, Khmelnytsky, Kherson, and Kharkiv oblasts targeting various Ukrainian regions including Chernihiv, Kyiv, Poltava, and Lviv areas (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74436).

sections.executive_summary: Russia has transitioned to a systematic campaign targeting Ukraine's economic and logistical rear, striking ports, metallurgical plants, data centers, fuel infrastructure, and logistics hubs across multiple oblasts, with estimated infrastructure damage reaching approximately $10 billion in 2026. Ukraine is simultaneously conducting strikes against Russian rear areas including Novorossiysk and oil/gas facilities in Saratov, Volgograd, Tula, and Samara regions. The detection of a Geran-5 missile-drone 10 km from Poland and a train locomotive strike 2 km from the Polish border signals increasing strike proximity to NATO territory, compounding the operational significance of the campaign.
ukraine: Russian strikes have destroyed or damaged power substations 'Nova' and 'Usatovo' supporting port and logistics infrastructure in two Ukrainian oblasts, according to the Russian Ministry of Defense (Source: @tass_agency/395208).
Three logistics centers in Odessa Oblast, including 'Nova Poshta,' and UAV production workshops were struck, per the Russian Ministry of Defense (Source: @tass_agency/395206).

Ukrainian metallurgical base has been hit hard: Zaporizhstal, enterprises in Krivoy Rog, Interpipe Steel, and the Northern and Novokrivy Rog iron ore mines were struck, affecting both military and civilian economic capacity (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33219).

Oleshky on Kherson Oblast remains under complete blockade with mined approaches and 24-hour shelling and drone attacks, leaving civilians without access to food, medicine, or essentials; humanitarian corridors have been requested by Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha (Source: @UkraineNow/84079).

Multiple Shahed drone launches were detected from Sumy heading to Chernihiv (15 drones), Chernihiv to Kyiv/Vyshhorod (10 drones), Zhytomyr to Khmelnytsky/Shepetivka (5 drones), and other corridors, indicating sustained mass drone operations (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74436).

Reactive UAVs were detected in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast near Pavlograd, Kamianske, and Petrykivka on a western course, and in Vinnytsia Oblast past Haisyn on a northwestern course from Kirovohrad (Source: @kpszsu/78109, @kpszsu/78122).

Reactive UAV groups were detected over Kyiv Oblast (2 groups) and Chernihiv Oblast (1 group), with additional drones detected heading to Zhmarynka in Vinnytsia and Skvyra in Kyiv (Source: @eRadarrua/113148, @eRadarrua/113099).
russia: Ukraine struck the Ozon logistics center in Saratov, which caught fire, and targeted oil, industrial, and warehouse facilities in Novorossiysk, Saratov, Volgograd, Tula, Samara regions, and Dagestan (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33219).
The Ukrainian side has stated it struck Russian oil and gas infrastructure, indicating both sides are now officially waging economic rear-area warfare (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33219).

Russian forces are maintaining the initiative on significant portions of the front, increasing pressure on the Dobropillia, Druzhkivka, and Zaporozhye directions, with heavy fighting around Orekhov and approaches to Druzhkivka (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33219).

Russian Ministry of Defense reports destruction of dry cargo ships and tugboats allegedly involved in transporting goods for the Ukrainian Armed Forces, as part of the maritime logistics disruption campaign (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33219).
A passenger train locomotive was struck in Volyn, 2 km from the Polish border, demonstrating Russian strike capability near NATO territory (Source: @eRadarrua/113150).
A Geran-5 missile-drone was detected 10 km from Poland, representing one of the closest confirmed strike platforms to NATO border territory (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74445).

Russian information sources have acknowledged reverses in the Krasnolymanska direction, where Ukrainian forces reportedly transferred reserves and broke through from the Drobyshevo direction in the northern part of the city, contradicting earlier official reports of steady advance (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33219).
eastern_front: Heavy fighting is taking place around Orekhov and in the approaches to Druzhkivka, with Russian forces increasing pressure on the Dobropillia, Druzhkivka, and Zaporozhye directions (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33219).

In the Krasnolymanska direction, Russian military sources reported that Ukrainian forces transferred reserves and broke through from the Drobyshevo direction, advancing in the northern part of the city, contradicting earlier official reports of Russian encirclement (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33219).

The front line increasingly resembles non-contiguous kill zones with small groups entering populated areas, losing supply lines, and being pursued by enemy groups, all monitored by reconnaissance and attack UAVs (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33219).

Jared Kushner acknowledged that the most difficult issue in negotiations remains territorial and is partly determined by the battlefield situation, though neither side has achieved a decisive operational breakthrough (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33219).
northern_front: Multiple Shahed drone corridors were detected from Sumy Oblast toward Chernihiv Oblast (Prilutsky and Nizhynsky districts, 15 drones), and from Chernihiv Oblast toward Kyiv Oblast (Vyshhorod district, 10 drones) (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74436).
Reactive UAV groups were detected over Kyiv Oblast (2 groups) and Chernihiv Oblast (1 group), indicating sustained northern drone activity (Source: @eRadarrua/113148).

A Shahed drone was detected circling on the outskirts of Ivano-Frankivsk, and 2 drones were detected heading to Stryi in Lviv Oblast, extending drone activity toward western Ukraine (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74436).

Reactive UAVs were detected from Zhytomyr Oblast heading to Khmelnytsky Oblast (Shepetivka district, 5 drones) and Rivne Oblast (Rivne district, 3 drones), as well as from Kyiv Oblast to Zhytomyr Oblast (Korosten district, 2 drones) (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74436).
southern_front: Oleshky on Kherson Oblast is under complete blockade with mined approaches and 24-hour shelling and drone attacks; humanitarian vehicles are being targeted, leaving civilians without food, medicine, or essentials (Source: @UkraineNow/84079).
Two Shahed drones were detected from Kherson Oblast heading toward the Black Sea aquatorium, and 1 drone from Kharkiv Oblast toward Poltava Oblast (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74436).
Reactive UAVs were detected at the border of Odessa and Mykolaiv oblasts on a northern course, indicating sustained southern drone activity (Source: @kpszsu/78120).

Strikes have targeted ports in Nikolaev and the Odessa region, including Chornomorsk (Ilyichevsk), with repeated attacks on terminals, warehouses, fuel supplies, and ships over recent weeks (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33219).
Three logistics centers in Odessa Oblast, including 'Nova Poshta,' and UAV workshops were struck by Russian forces (Source: @tass_agency/395206).
air_war: A Geran-5 missile-drone was detected 10 km from Poland, representing a significant escalation in strike platform proximity to NATO territory (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74445).
Vilnius airport was closed due to detection of unidentified UAVs in the airspace, though the possible affiliation and trajectory were not specified (Source: @tass_agency/395185).

Mass Shahed drone launches were detected across multiple Ukrainian corridors: 15 from Sumy to Chernihiv, 10 from Chernihiv to Kyiv, 5 from Zhytomyr to Khmelnytsky, 3 from Zhytomyr to Rivne, 2 from Kyiv to Zhytomyr, 2 from Khmelnytsky to Ternopil, 2 to Stryi (Lviv), 2 from Kherson to Black Sea, and 1 from Kharkiv to Poltava (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74436).

Reactive UAVs were detected across Dnipropetrovsk Oblast (Pavlograd, Kamianske, Petrykivka, western course), Vinnytsia Oblast (past Haisyn, northwestern course from Kirovohrad), and at the Odessa-Mykolaiv border (northern course) (Sources: @kpszsu/78109, @kpszsu/78122, @kpszsu/78120).

Ukrainian UAV strikes have targeted Russian rear areas including Novorossiysk, Saratov, Volgograd, Tula, Samara regions, and Dagestan, hitting oil, industrial, warehouse, and logistics facilities (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33219).
A passenger train locomotive was struck in Volyn, 2 km from the Polish border, demonstrating precision strike capability near NATO territory (Source: @eRadarrua/113150).

Both sides are conducting sustained UAV and missile campaigns against rear infrastructure: Russia targeting Ukrainian logistics, metallurgy, and energy nodes, while Ukraine targets Russian oil, gas, and logistics facilities (Sources: @ukr_leaks_eng/33219, @tass_agency/395208, @tass_agency/395206).
key_developments: Russia has shifted to systemic strikes against Ukraine's rear infrastructure, targeting ports, logistics hubs, metallurgical plants (Zaporizhstal, Interpipe Steel), data centers, and fuel facilities across multiple oblasts, with estimated damage reaching approximately $10 billion in 2026, fundamentally altering the economic and negotiation dynamics (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33219).

A Geran-5 missile-drone was detected 10 km from Poland and a passenger train locomotive was struck in Volyn 2 km from the Polish border, demonstrating escalating strike proximity to NATO territory and raising alliance security concerns (Sources: @mon1tor_ua/74445, @eRadarrua/113150).

Russian forces struck power substations 'Nova' and 'Usatovo' supporting port logistics, and three logistics centers in Odessa Oblast including 'Nova Poshta' plus UAV workshops, systematically degrading Ukraine's supply infrastructure (Sources: @tass_agency/395208, @tass_agency/395206).

Ukraine struck the Ozon logistics center in Saratov and targeted oil, industrial, and warehouse facilities across Novorossiysk, Saratov, Volgograd, Tula, Samara regions, and Dagestan, officially confirming strikes on Russian oil and gas infrastructure (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33219).

Oleshky on Kherson Oblast remains under complete blockade with mined approaches and constant shelling, with civilians lacking food, medicine, and essentials; Foreign Minister Sybiha has called for international humanitarian corridors (Source: @UkraineNow/84079).

Mass Shahed drone launches were detected across at least 10 corridors targeting Ukrainian regions from Sumy and Chernihiv in the north to Kherson and Kharkiv in the south, with reactive UAV groups also active over Kyiv and Chernihiv oblasts (Sources: @mon1tor_ua/74436, @eRadarrua/113148).

In the Krasnolymanska direction, Ukrainian forces reportedly broke through from the Drobyshevo direction in the northern part of the city after Russian sources had previously claimed encirclement, exposing significant discrepancies in Russian force reporting (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33219).
sections.threat_assessment: The systematic nature of Russian strikes on Ukraine's economic rear — targeting ports, metallurgy, data centers, and logistics — represents a strategic shift aimed at degrading Ukraine's war-fighting capacity and reducing its attractiveness to Western capital. The simultaneous Ukrainian strikes on Russian oil, gas, and logistics infrastructure in multiple regions indicate mutual escalation of economic warfare. The detection of strike platforms 10 km and 2 km from the Polish border, combined with Vilnius airport closures due to unidentified UAVs, raises the risk of inadvertent NATO involvement. The Oleshky blockade constitutes a humanitarian crisis with potential for further destabilization in southern Ukraine.
sections.regional_response: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha has called on international partners to create humanitarian corridors for Oleshky, highlighting the complete blockade and civilian suffering in occupied Kherson Oblast. Jared Kushner has acknowledged that territorial issues remain the most difficult negotiation point, with a peace deal reportedly contingent on Ukraine accepting Kremlin red lines in Donbas. The escalation of strikes near NATO borders (Poland, Lithuania) may compel allied nations to accelerate air defense deployments and tighten surveillance of the airspace. Both sides are now officially waging economic rear-area warfare, with no indication of de-escalation.
sections.intelligence_notes: Russian information operations in the Krasnolymanska direction have shown significant discrepancies between official claims of encirclement and ground reality of Ukrainian counterattacks from the Drobyshevo direction, undermining the credibility of Russian force reporting. The targeting of data centers and information storage nodes represents a new element in the conflict, indicating recognition of the digital infrastructure's role in sustaining front-line operations. The formation of non-contiguous kill zones monitored by reconnaissance and attack UAVs suggests a fundamental transformation in frontline tactics, where territorial control is increasingly assessed by drone surveillance rather than physical trench lines. The economic damage estimate of approximately $10 billion from air strikes in 2026 underscores the campaign's strategic scale.
